name: Second Wind
effect: While your fortress is below 90% health, skills recharge a further 5% faster.
flavour: Knocked down is not knocked out.

name: Overclock
effect: If your skill cooldown bonus is over 25%, your heroes deal +25% damage.

name: Lone Wolf
effect: +200% ATK. Each hero after the first cuts this bonus by 90%.
flavour: An army is just a crowd waiting to scatter.

name: Hardy Stock
effect: All your heroes and summons gain +5% max health.
flavour: Built to last, every one of them.
